claims.text: The trip record and the GPS trace describe the same trip and the same measurement: both carry trip_id TRP-02824, both start at 16:11:03 and end at 16:32:43, and the trace's own trace_distance_km is 14.4 km against a booked optimal of 2.4 km. The rider's burden under POL-RD-08(a) is met on matching identifiers and pickup timestamp across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown.

The excess is 12.0 km and 500% of the booked optimal route. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass by an enormous margin (excess greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km), and the excess also exceeds the 50% / 8.0 km materiality gate, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED and MATERIAL. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km (14.4 km), not the rounded trip_record copy, as POL-RD-01 requires.

The trace is clean for policy purposes: 131 fixes at a 10 second sample interval, 100.0% coverage, zero gaps and a max_gap_sec of 0.0. No limb of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) fires, so the deviation may be established on the gps_trace alone and no independent corroboration is required.

The driver's only explanation is a bare assertion in the counterparty statement that 'the rider changed the destination verbally'. That is not a rider instruction recorded in the chat_log as POL-RD-04(a) requires, and the chat log for this trip contains zero messages. POL-RD-04 is unavailable on this record and the assertion discharges nothing under POL-RD-08.

No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-02824-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and no external traffic cause can exonerate any part of the excess. Under POL-RD-13 the driver's traffic excuse, if any, carries no weight and the deviation stands at the measured figure.

No pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded: original_pickup, original_dropoff, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are all null, and amended_optimal_distance_km is null. POL-RD-05 cannot be invoked to re-baseline the optimal route, so the booked 2.4 km optimal stands.

The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs. The recomputed fare on the booked optimal route is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 + 0.28 x 5.0) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = 7.80, against a charged_total of 21.48. The refund is 21.48 - 7.80 = 13.68, which is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 13.70 after rounding up to the nearest SGD 0.05.

The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines and no airport surcharge (tolls_erp 0.0, airport_surcharge 0.0), so there is no off-route pass-through to add on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and no billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4). The refund is the distance-and-time recomputation alone.

The driver's profile does not establish a repeat deviation pattern: deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 210, so neither limb of POL-RD-06 fires and no FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral follows from the profile. I do not claim the uplift.
The rider's own profile does not trigger the extra-corroboration rule: deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so no corroboration beyond the gps_trace is required for this claim.

claims.text: The GPS trace for this trip measures 14.4 km against a booked optimal route of 2.4 km, an excess of 12.0 km and 500% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests are passed many times over (excess greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%), and the excess also clears the materiality gate (greater than 8.0 km and greater than 50%). The trace is the governing field under POL-RD-01, and it is clean: 131 fixes, 100% coverage, 10 s sampling, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0.

The rider has discharged the initial burden under POL-RD-08: the trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02824 and the trace's first fix (2026-08-29T16:11:03+08:00) matches the trip_record's started_at, and the excess meets the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden therefore shifts to the driver to point to a specific artifact and clause.

The driver's only explanation is the counterparty_statement 'The rider changed the destination verbally.' That is an assertion with no artifact behind it. The chat_log for this trip contains 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint and no road named; POL-RD-04(a) to (c) cannot be satisfied and the corroboration test cannot even be run. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID carries no weight and is discarded.

No traffic advisory covers this trip. The only advisory artifact in the bundle is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run: there is no named road, no validity window and no shortest_lawful_alternative_km to cap any exoneration. The driver has named no advisory ID, so under POL-RD-13(1) this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, and the deviation stands at the measured figure.

No relocation clause is available to the driver. The trip_record shows original_pickup, original_dropoff, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at all null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min both null. There is no amended endpoint to re-quote against, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and the booked 2.4 km optimal stands as the baseline.

The trip is not a pooled trip. vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12 does not apply and no co-rider collection distance is excluded from the excess.

The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs and the refund is arithmetic. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 + 0.28 x 5.0) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 waiting fee - 0 promo = 7.80. Charged_total is 21.48, so the refund is 21.48 - 7.80 = 13.68, rounded up to SGD 13.70. That is 63.7% of charged_total, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 13.70. The surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, not from the trip_record.

The driver's profile does not support a repeat-deviation uplift, and I do not claim one. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 210, so the POL-RD-06 pattern test (3 or more flags, or a ratio of 0.05 or more) is not met. The POL-RD-02 partial refund is the correct remedy and no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) is available on this record.

No ERP or surcharge correction is due either way. The fare_breakdown carries 0.00 of ERP, no gantry lines, no airport surcharge and no waiting-time fee, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport. POL-RD-09 therefore adds nothing to the POL-RD-02 figure and nothing is double-counted.

The rider's profile is context only and I do not rely on it. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the threshold of 4 that POL-RD-08 sets for requiring extra corroboration, so no additional corroboration burden attaches to this claim; and no other rider_profile field may ground a finding under POL-GEN-01.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this is the ruling on trip TRP-02824 (29 Aug 2026).

WHAT THE EVIDENCE SHOWS. The platform's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02824) records 14.4 km driven between the recorded pickup (Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru) and the recorded drop-off (Blk 25 Ghim Moh Link). That trace is clean: 131 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 s, so no limb of POL-RD-07(a)–(c) fires and the trace is not impaired for policy purposes; no independent corroboration is needed. The booked optimal route on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02824) is 2.4 km. The excess is therefore 12.0 km, or 500% of optimal. That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (excess greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km) and also the materiality gate (greater than 50% and greater than 8.0 km). As POL-RD-01 requires, I have measured on gps_trace.trace_distance_km (14.4 km), which governs over the trip record's rounded copy. The deviation is ESTABLISHED and MATERIAL.

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. The driver says the rider changed the destination verbally. POL-RD-04 requires such an instruction to be recorded in the chat log for this trip with a timestamp and a place or road specific enough to act on, and to be corroborated by the trace passing within 200 m of chat_message.waypoint_hint. The chat log for this trip (EV-CHAT-02824) contains zero messages, so there is no recorded instruction, no waypoint hint and no named road: POL-RD-04 cannot be run, and the statement, which cites no evidence id, carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and is discarded. POL-RD-05 is also unavailable: original_pickup, original_dropoff, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are all null, so there is no amended endpoint to re-quote against. POL-RD-12 does not apply (vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL). No traffic advisory exists for this trip — EV-ADVIS-02824-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 — and no party asserted an external traffic cause against a cited advisory, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) escalation.

THE MONEY. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs arithmetically:
• charged_total = SGD 21.48 (EV-FARE-02824)
• recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 × 2.4 + 0.28 × 5.0) × 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 7.80. The surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, not from the trip record.
• refund = 21.48 − 7.80 = SGD 13.68, rounded UP to SGD 13.70.
That is 63.7% of the charged total — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share — so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 13.70. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: the fare breakdown carries 0.00 ERP, no gantry lines, no airport surcharge and no waiting-time fee, so there is no off-route pass-through to stack on top and no billing-integrity defect. No driver compensation is due: the distance billed (14.4 km) is not less than the distance the trace records (14.4 km), so the POL-RD-04 unbilled-kilometre limb does not arise.

NO UPLIFT AND NO REFERRAL. Because the deviation is material I consulted the driver profile (EV-DPROF-02824): deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 210 completed trips in 90 days, so neither limb of the POL-RD-06 pattern test is met, there is no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). No POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral arises either. The rider's profile is context only (POL-GEN-01); rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the threshold of 4, so no extra corroboration is required and it could not have denied an otherwise proven claim.

ESCALATION CHECKS. Identifiers match across trip record, trace and fare breakdown; timestamps agree; the trace is not impaired; no exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact; the refund is far below SGD 150.00 and below the charged total; and confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires, so this is a money ruling and not an escalation. The rider's discarded claim about the missing advisory (it cited the missing artifact without naming its issue code) is recorded in the audit trail.

EXECUTION. The monetary effect, SGD 13.70, exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the amount is issued but not released automatically; the case goes to the human release queue under POL-GEN-05. Both parties retain the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the charge for trip TRP-02824 (RDR-09824 / DRV-09824) is partly refunded.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02824) is clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 131 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0, so none of limbs (a) to (c) fires. (The schema pre-pass also tagged it COMPLETE, so there is no schema impairment and no policy impairment — the two are stated separately as POL-GEN-02 and POL-RD-07 require.) The trace measures the trip at 14.4 km (trace_distance_km, the governing field under POL-RD-01). The booked optimal route on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02824) is 2.4 km. The excess is therefore 12.0 km, 500% of optimal: both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) and the excess also clears the materiality gate (greater than 50% and greater than 8.0 km). The deviation is ESTABLISHED and MATERIAL, corroborated by the trip record's own optimal-distance field, which is a platform routing-engine estimate rather than a copy of the trace.

NO EXONERATION. The driver's statement in the dispute record — that the rider changed the destination verbally — is an assertion that cites no evidence ID; under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight and is discarded. It is also contradicted in form by the record: the chat log for this trip (EV-CHAT-02824) contains 0 messages, so there is no recorded rider instruction, no waypoint_hint and no named road. POL-RD-04 cannot be satisfied and, as that clause directs, its corroboration test could not be run; the case is decided on the remaining clauses. POL-RD-05 cannot re-baseline the route either: original_pickup, original_dropoff, pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are all null and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so there is no amended endpoint to re-quote against. The only advisory artifact (EV-ADVIS-02824-01) is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and no payload, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and no external traffic cause can reduce the excess; under POL-RD-13 that absence is a gap in the bundle (the driver named no advisory ID), not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The vehicle type is RYDE_X and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12 does not apply.

THE REFUND. fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs and the refund is arithmetic. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 2.4 km + 0.28 x 5.0 min) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 waiting fee - 0 promo = 7.80. The surge multiplier of 1.0 is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, not from the trip record. Charged_total is 21.48. Refund = 21.48 - 7.80 = 13.68, rounded UP to SGD 13.70. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis, and at 63.7% of charged_total it is below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND, not a FULL_REFUND.

PASS-THROUGH LINES. The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines, no airport surcharge, no tolls and no waiting-time fee, and the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport. POL-RD-09 therefore adds nothing on top of the POL-RD-02 figure and nothing is double-counted.

NO DRIVER UPLIFT OR REFERRAL. Because the deviation is MATERIAL, the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check was run: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 210 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established. There is no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). No other referral is produced by any clause: there are no unmatched charge lines (POL-RD-09(4)) and no false-arrival record (POL-NS-05(ii)). Profile fields outside the citable counters (ratings, active_region, lifetime counters) were treated as context only under POL-GEN-01 and grounded nothing.
